description: This file contains implementation code for LXC container management within the WPEFramework, including classes for iterating network interfaces, managing container lifecycle, configuration, and logging.

classes.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating network interfaces of an LXC container, providing methods to traverse, access, and manage network interface data.

classes.name: LXCContainer
classes.description: Represents an LXC container, providing methods for lifecycle management, configuration, resource monitoring, and network interface access.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for LXC container settings, including console logging and additional configuration items.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes network interface list by querying the container for existing network interfaces.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next network interface.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous network interface.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator position to an initial state.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Index
methods.description: Returns the current index of the iterator.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of network interfaces.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::~LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
methods.description: Destructor that frees allocated memory for network interface data.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network interface.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::NumAddresses
methods.description: Returns the number of IP addresses associated with the current network interface.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Address
methods.description: Returns the IP address at the specified index for the current network interface.

methods.name: LXCContainer::LXCContainer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an LXC container object with configuration and state.

methods.name: LXCContainer::~LXCContainer
methods.description: Destructor that stops the container if running and releases resources.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Id
methods.description: Returns the container's identifier.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage information for the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CPU usage information for the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the container's network interfaces.

methods.name: LXCContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: LXCContainer::AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the container object.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and releases the container object if no longer used.

methods.name: LXCContainer::InheritRequestedEnvironment
methods.description: Inherits environment variables from host into container configuration.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Config
methods.description: Constructor initializing container configuration parameters.
